name: fix77_sleep
verifies: fix-77: lying down in a bed opens the bed's own G3 dialog (PS_Interact_SleepBed → AssessTalk → the bed's infos): 'sleep until the next morning / noon / the next evening / midnight' and 'End'; choosing morning skips the clock to 08:00 and refills HP (PlayerSleep), the hero gets up; 'End' gets up without sleeping
notes: FILLERX293…296 are the Bed_01 template's infos (8, 12, 20, midnight); BPANKRATZ30 is the hero's general 'End' (Закончить). Other bed templates (Bed_02…06) own their own four infos with the same texts. ESC in the menu moves the mark to 'End' (G3 gCHUDListCtrlDialog).
